title: Holy Fire Bible Study
description:
Holy Fire Bible Study brings the King James Version of 1611 — all 80 books and 36,684 verses, including the Apocrypha — into one focused app where you can read, search, and put your scripture knowledge to the test. Whether you want a quiet study tool or a fast trivia challenge, it plays comfortably from the couch on Steam Deck and controller.

Read & Study

Browse the complete 1611 KJV, including the Apocrypha

Search the entire text instantly and jump between every match

Bookmark verses and pick up right where you left off

Test Your Knowledge

Four trivia types: fill in the blank, name the book, identify the speaker, and true-or-false

Focus on a single book or play across the whole canon

Three difficulty levels that tighten the clock as you climb

Score for speed and accuracy, chase the leaderboard, and unlock achievements

Built for the Couch

Full controller support, designed for Steam Deck

On-screen keyboard search, with adjustable music and sound

On the Horizon

New music and more trivia coming in future updates
description_short: A KJV 1611 scripture reader and Bible trivia game in one. Search, bookmark, and study every book including the Apocrypha, then test your recall with four question types, climb the leaderboard, and unlock achievements. Built for controller and fully playable on Steam Deck.
